profile.purpose: Deterministic, authority-side and Unity-side per-tick witness comparison.

defaultComparison.meaning: A comparison result is evidence for its listed witness only; it does not certify uncovered contracts.

witnesses.title: dense-input-rng
witnesses.evidence: Both producers emit the current v3 input and RNG domains for every fixed tick.

witnesses.title: frame-wait-immediate
witnesses.evidence: The existing frameCounterProbe checks wait preservation and immediate-frame wait reset on both producers.

witnesses.title: structural-spawn-free-slot-sequence
witnesses.evidence: Detached diagnostic fixture runs the real Unity late live scan and registry lifecycle while the authority exporter drives the same fixed Objects[0..399] scan and SpawnAt/FreeEntity operations.

witnesses.title: structural-stage-dynamic-allocation
witnesses.evidence: Both diagnostic fixtures execute lowest-free searches from general 0, stage 20, and dynamic 50, plus the inclusive Authority400 tail slot 399.

witnesses.title: structural-collision-hitresolve
witnesses.evidence: W06CollisionHitResolveWitnessEditorTests executes the real Unity RunInteractionPhase order and the production collision carrier/character hit consume path. It proves character-hit consume precedes the natural random-drop RNG gate, object-hit consume observes that RNG side effect, and frozen candidates resolve in ascending runtime-slot order without later geometry/team re-filtering. Authority anchors: GameTick.cs lines 105-111 and HitResolve.cs lines 24-64.

witnesses.title: structural-positive-link-validation
witnesses.evidence: The authority fixture reaches private ValidatePositiveLinks through public GameTick.Run observation hooks; Unity executes the real ValidateHeldLinksAll. Tick 2 keeps reciprocal forward/reverse links and tick 3 clears only holder forward fields after a reverse holder mismatch.
